name: Smart Diff — role groups, group hints, findings counter and order toggle
description: Walks the Files changed tab's Smart Diff view (L03): the grouped-by-role header, two groups' hint text, the findings counter on the group that has them, a seeded changed file rendered inside its group, and a file with no fetched patch showing the 'no diff text' placeholder — then Original order swaps in the flat GitHub-order list and Smart order restores the grouping. Per-group file counts and the 'Grouped by role, most relevant first' hint's disappearance under Original order are counted in DiffTab.test.tsx / DiffGroup.test.tsx — this suite has no negative wait, so it only asserts what (re)appears. Never touches a finding's Accept/Reject/Learn (FindingCard's own tests) and never clicks Run Review or Re-run — both call the LLM. Read-only seeded data (server/src/db/seed.ts's PR #482 files and findings), no model call. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml.
